name: illustration-system
description: Use this skill when the user wants website or product illustrations in one consistent visual style — spot and section illustrations, empty states, onboarding art, 404 pages, feature graphics, or more images matching existing samples. It decodes a style into a written contract (six axes: composition, fill discipline, light logic, palette, character language, geometry), conditions generation on sample references, and produces native SVG illustration sets that hold the style across any subject, delivered as SVGs plus transparent PNGs.
